title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons up to version 10.0.2. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that can impact confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
